pages.title: Beishan Shop
pages.text: Wandering traders are replaced by the Beishan Shop, trading emeralds for items:$(li)Nag Megaphone 16$(li)Pigeon Trap 12$(li)Infra Pickaxe 32$(li)Beishan Photo 8$(li)NBT Viewer 20$(li)Structure Airdrop 24

pages.title: Team Circle
pages.text: Hold right click for 3 seconds with a coin (costs 1): radius 10 blocks, lasts 10 minutes.$(br2)Crops inside grow faster and mining yields more experience.
